notes.title: Gunslinger's Paradise: John Cooper reveals Desperados III's release date!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33465443/107a5b8f19ea7c09e9ca6aa28faa96e507986d22.jpg[/img]

He's almost quicker to the draw than his own shadow, and his bullets always hit their mark. When the smoke from his revolvers slowly clears, you can read it clearly: JUNE. 16. 2020. Yeeehaw, folks! Desperados III finally has a release date, presented by the notorious gunslinger John Cooper himself. 

So shoot it into your calendars, Desperados III will be available for PC, Xbox One™ and PlayStation®4 on June 16th, 2020. 

Watch the brandnew John Cooper Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jwyYiURDMtY

Desperados III is available for pre-order now on PC at an SRP of € 49.99 / $ 49.99 / £ 44.99 (PC). 

[b]For the early adopters: The Digital Deluxe Edition is available for pre-order for the price of the Standard Edition during this pre-order phase! Make sure to shoot first, and ask questions later.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/610370/

Enjoy & stay tuned!
Your Mimimi Games & THQ Nordic Teams
